records.subject: message_lifecycle_projection
records.owner: Thread Service and runtime event owners
records.persistence: canonical thread record and runtime evidence; message expansion remains view state
records.privacy: No raw helper payload, credential, or hidden reasoning.

records.subject: message_supersession_and_branch_lineage
records.privacy: Immutable source refs; no reconstruction from content-free tombstones.

records.subject: requested_effective_route_snapshot
records.persistence: thread request snapshot and shared account/model registries; favorites/defaults belong in Settings
records.privacy: Human labels only; no tokens, OAuth codes, or credential paths.

records.subject: thread_local_view_state
events: local view-state change receipt only when diagnostics require it
records.persistence: thread-local client state; explicit product decision needed before cross-client sync
records.privacy: Do not store message bodies redundantly.

records.subject: draft_revision_history
records.owner: Thread Service or canonical draft persistence owner
records.persistence: durable per-thread draft and bounded revision history; never leaks between threads
records.privacy: Local spellcheck is passive; code, paths, URLs, hashes, and known identifiers are excluded from correction.

records.subject: questionnaire_lifecycle
records.owner: shared question tool and requesting parent runtime
records.persistence: durable queue, answers, skips, cancellation and submission history; no passive expiry
records.privacy: Only the parent-facing bounded question/answer record is shared with children.

records.subject: context_admission_and_subcompact
records.persistence: owner receipt and summary artifact; local transient selection unless canon promotes it
records.privacy: No whole AGENTS files, whole tool catalogs, raw system prompt, or hidden reasoning.

records.subject: goal_work_projection
events: Goal Runtime owner events and allowed-action receipts
records.persistence: canonical Goal state on the Project Home Server
records.privacy: Chat consumes evidence refs and human summaries rather than raw private payloads.

records.subject: child_and_crew_projection
records.privacy: Assistant memory is not automatically copied into children.

records.subject: artifact_workspace_projection
records.persistence: Artifact Service; selected workspace identity may be thread-local view state
records.privacy: Redaction and protected paths are enforced by owners before projection.

records.subject: attachment_resolution
records.owner: FileSafe, media capability, model routing and artifact owners
records.persistence: thread attachment refs and derived artifact lineage
records.privacy: Alternate-provider routing requires explicit consent when the boundary changes.

records.subject: outbox_replay_snapshot
records.owner: Project Home Server and environment connection supervision
records.persistence: durable server/client outbox contract with exactly-once command identity
records.privacy: Queued payload follows the same permission and redaction policy as live dispatch.

records.subject: bsd_projection
records.persistence: thread-local value; broader default only through Settings
records.privacy: Read-only review; cannot mutate or become an authority channel.

records.subject: resource_and_usage_projection
records.owner: RuntimeResourceGovernor, worktree/test/browser/debug owners, ObservableWork and Usage
records.persistence: canonical owner records; Chat keeps only refs and view state
records.privacy: Logs and raw provider payloads are opened through owner surfaces with redaction.

records.subject: notification_and_decision_receipts
records.owner: canonical notification owner plus runtime/permission/route decision owners
records.persistence: owner receipt and title-bar notification record; Chat inline projection is not a second inbox
records.privacy: No secret or protected authentication content in notifications.

event_registry_gaps: Questionnaire lifecycle and thread request/await/spawn event names need exact owner registration before production wiring.
Local view-state changes should not be promoted to durable EventRecord traffic without a cross-client persistence requirement.
Do not fabricate generic command_applied events; every command uses an owner event or explicit dispatch receipt.
All-thread search and exact unloaded-range navigation need an explicit result/currentness contract if cmd.chat.search does not already accept scope.
